name: Thirst for Blood applies its two Thirst tiers (#512)
contract: Thirst for Blood 570023: 'Between 1-5 stacks of Thirst: Spell haste increased by $570024s1%. Between 6-10 stacks of Thirst: The bonus damage dealt by spell critical strikes is increased by $570025s1%.' Both of its effects are aura 4 (SPELL_AURA_DUMMY) with Amplitude 500 and a TriggerSpell (570025 on effect 0, 570024 on effect 1). Aura 4 never ticks - only aura 226 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DUMMY is wired into AuraEffect::PeriodicTick - and a TriggerSpell on a dummy aura is inert data, so neither tier was ever applied. 570024 'Sated' is aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS with BasePoints 9 / DieSides 1 (10%); 570025 'Ravenous' is aura 163 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, MiscValue 126 (all magic schools), BasePoints 99 / DieSides 1 (100%) plus Effect 164 SPELL_EFFECT_REMOVE_AURA on 570024, which is what keeps the tiers exclusive. The Thirst resource itself is 706613 (AscensionResourceTalents.cpp:17). cast_speed_multiplier observes the native cast-time multiplier, so smaller is faster.

steps.label: Cast speed with no Thirst tier
Let the record's own 500 ms re-evaluation run
No tier applies at zero Thirst
One to five stacks apply Sated
Sated carries its own 10% spell haste
Ravenous does not apply below six stacks
Six to ten stacks apply Ravenous
Ravenous carries its own 100% critical damage bonus
No tier survives at zero Thirst
